tools.name: search_adventures
tools.description: Search published adrenaline activities on Adrenaline List by text, destination slug, category slug, adrenaline rating (1-10), months and maximum duration. Use list_search_options for valid slugs. Prices are indicative.

tools.name: get_adventure
tools.description: Get full public details for one published adventure by slug, including requirements, review summary and the operator contact shown on the public page.

tools.name: list_search_options
tools.description: List destination (country) and category slugs with published activity counts, for use with search_adventures.

labels.name: list_my_adventures
labels.description: List the signed-in member's own adventures on Adrenaline List: their bucket list and the adventures they have done, with slug, title, status, visibility, notes and completion date. Filter by status (done or bucket_list); 50 per page. Requires sign-in.

labels.name: mark_adventure
labels.description: Add a published adventure to the signed-in member's bucket list or mark it as done, by slug (from search_adventures). labels.name: unmark_adventure
labels.description: Remove an adventure from the signed-in member's bucket list or done list, by slug, including one that is no longer published. Removing one that is on neither list changes nothing. Requires sign-in.

labels.name: get_my_stats
labels.description: The signed-in member's Adrenaline List stats: adventures done, bucket list size and countries visited, plus their profile URL when they have a public profile with a username. Requires sign-in.
